explanation: The theorem states that p-components of the centralizer of an orthogonal linear involution-type operator, and of the fixed subgroup of a projective conjugation, are quasisimple. It is built from the library's own CFSG definitions (CFSG.IsPComponent, CFSG.IsQuasisimple, orthogonalOperatorCentralizer, projectiveConjugation, FixedCommutingProduct.fixedSubgroup). Its proof only combines two library lemmas, original_centralizer_pComponent_quasisimple and projective_fixed_pComponent_quasisimple. Mathlib has no theory of p-components or of the classification of finite simple groups, and no statement about quasisimplicity of components in orthogonal groups over finite fields. I did not run a search of the Mathlib sources, so this rests on my knowledge of Mathlib rather than a grep. None_found does not claim that no such declaration exists.
